# latitudesh_filesystem_storage (Data Source)

Retrieve a [filesystem](https://www.latitude.sh/docs/storage/filesystem) by `id`, or by `name` (optionally narrowed with `project`).

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "latitudesh_filesystem_storage" "shared" {
  name    = "shared-data"
  project = "proj_..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Filesystem identifier to look up.
- `name` (String) Filesystem name to look up.
- `project` (String) Project ID or slug to filter a `name` lookup by.

### Read-Only

- `file_endpoint` (String) Endpoint to mount the filesystem from.
- `nfs_mount_path` (String) Mount path of the filesystem.
- `protocols` (Set of String) NFS protocols enabled on the filesystem: `nfs3`, `nfs4` or both.
- `region` (String) Region (site) slug where the filesystem is provisioned.
- `size_in_gb` (Number) Filesystem size, in GB.
